{{Top|leg}}
The '''State of the Republic address''' was a speech given by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the current state of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The addresses drew many offworld [[Senator/Legends|Senators]], government officials, businessmen, and the like back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to witness the address; afterwards, they customarily held large parties.

State of the Republic Addresses were considered an archaic tradition during the last few centuries of the Galactic Republic, and [[Eixes Valorum]] was the last Chancellor to give such addresses. However, they were temporarily revived by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[State of the Republic address (19 BBY)|His addresses]] were frequently punctuated by massive applause from the Senators, and could last as long as four hours.

==Behind the scenes==
Although ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' states that Eixes Valorum was the last Chancellor to give State of the Republic addresses before Palpatine, in [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] Palpatine mentions such addresses being given by [[Thoris Darus]], [[Frix]], [[Kalpana (Supreme Chancellor)/Legends|Kalpana]], and [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].
